title: MIT Technology Review Insights: Adapting to new threats with proactive risk management
subject: MIT Technology Review Insights: Adapting to new threats with proactive risk management
body:
MIT Technology Review Insights: Adapting to new threats with proactive risk managementCyber threats are evolving quickly, and customers are under pressure to strengthen resilience before disruption happens.

The MIT Technology Review Insights report, Adapting to New Threats with Proactive Risk Management, gives you a timely way to start conversations around risk, resilience and business continuity.

Use the research to help customers think beyond reactive security and take a more proactive approach to protecting critical data and operations.

We’ve made it easy to take that message to market. The Cyber Risk Mitigation & Recovery campaign is ready in the Partner Marketing Hub with co-brandable emails, social content and customer-facing assets.

Start the conversation today and put a ready-to-launch campaign to work for your business.
